It profiles four LockBit affiliate intrusions, the AQUATIC PANDA campaign, two healthcare ransomware affiliate cases (Phobos and ALPHV), ISO-file phishing trends, and exploitation of ProxyShell and a Confluence vulnerability. It also reviews emerging, trending and mainstay tools.
